android-sharesdk-integration 1.0.1

- Added an interactive 6-step workflow to guide users through MobTech ShareSDK integration in Android projects.
- Skill detects intent based on common phrases and keywords such as “我要在app中增加分享能力”, “ShareSDK集成”, and platform/share-related configuration requests.
- Provides user prompts and validation at each step: project path validation, config file generation/verification, Gradle and SDK integration, privacy compliance guidance, and code insertion for privacy and share actions.
- Ensures type-safe extraction of Excel configuration values with detailed user-facing validation error messages.
- Supports step-by-step confirmation before executing actions or modifying files.
